evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Create game is present and complementary capabilities (invite PP-002, browse PP-016, delete PP-020, view transcript PP-017) exist in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Invitation by URL is supported and join-by-URL (PP-029) exists; no missing complementary capability is required by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round (item creation for a round) is covered and item list/read/edit/delete stories (PP-004, PP-006, PP-007, PP-008) exist.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Reading/listing items is present and has complementary add/edit/delete (PP-006, PP-007, PP-008).

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting items is supported by item management stories (PP-004, PP-006, PP-013) so no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Add item is present along with edit (PP-007) and delete (PP-008), so CRUD for items is complete.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Edit exists and is complemented by add (PP-006) and delete (PP-008); no missing complementary requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Delete capability is present together with add/edit/read (PP-006, PP-007, PP-004); set is complete for item lifecycle.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Immediate-show feature complements the normal show-after-all (PP-033); both behaviors are represented—no missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting computed result is present and complemented by manual agreed estimate entry (PP-012); no missing complement.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: This behavior can be implemented using existing show/collect estimates stories (PP-033, PP-032); no additional complementary story is required.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual acceptance/editing of the agreed estimate complements computed acceptance (PP-010) and item storage; no missing stories identified.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation is supported via item selection and item list (PP-005, PP-004); no necessary complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories is explicitly requested and complemented by copy/paste (PP-015) and item CRUD (PP-006 etc.); no missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste option complements import (PP-014) and item CRUD; no missing complementary story required.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is present and complemented by viewing transcripts (PP-017) and deleting games (PP-020); required complements exist.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Transcript viewing is paired with export options (PP-018, PP-019) and browsing (PP-016); no complementary capability missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting as HTML complements viewing (PP-017) and CSV export (PP-019); transcript storage/viewing is covered so no missing complement.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export complements transcript viewing (PP-017) and HTML export (PP-018); underlying data storage/viewing is present.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Delete game exists and is complemented by browse (PP-016) and account management (PP-021..PP-024) to control ownership; complementary stories present.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to create an account for the application
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is present and complemented by login (PP-022), change (PP-023), delete (PP-024) and password reminder (PP-026).

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login complements account creation (PP-021) and password reminder (PP-026); no required complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account update is present and complements create/delete (PP-021, PP-024); required complements exist.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is present with account create/login/change (PP-021..PP-023); complementary account lifecycle stories exist.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display is a presentation detail and doesn't expose a missing complementary backend capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder is present and complements account creation/login (PP-021, PP-022); email sending capability is implied but not a missing story.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Card-set selection is a standalone configuration item; no complementary story is required to make it implementable in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Invite limit is specified and is compatible with invite/join stories (PP-002, PP-029); no necessary complementary capability absent.

evaluations.evidence: As an estimator, I want to join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Join-by-URL is present and complements invite (PP-002); user identity is minimal and consistent with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: As an estimator, I want to see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Displaying the current item is covered and complements moderator item selection (PP-005); no missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: As an estimator, I want to see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Estimator item list is covered by item-list stories (PP-004) and participant scroll (PP-039); complementary capabilities present.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Showing who has estimated is supported and complements join (PP-029) and show-all behaviors (PP-033); no missing complement.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Synchronized reveal behavior is present and complemented by ability to show early (PP-009) and estimate change rules (PP-034, PP-041); no missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Change-until-reveal is aligned with reveal behavior (PP-033) and change-as-long-as-not-complete (PP-041); complementary stories exist.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to be able to see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates is supported by scroll-back (PP-039) and transcript/history stories (PP-017); required complements present.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Displaying per-estimator estimates is covered and complements reveal and identity (PP-033, PP-032); no missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer start/share functionality is self-contained and complemented by timer reset (PP-038); no additional complementary story is required.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Timer reset behavior complements the shared timer start (PP-037) and the reveal logic (PP-033); no missing complements.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Scroll-back/history is present and complemented by transcript/export/browse stories (PP-017, PP-016); no missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering requirement is a UI detail and does not expose any missing complementary capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: This change rule complements reveal/completion behavior (PP-033) and is represented; no required complementary capability missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a participant, I want to have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying a thumbnail implies users can set/upload a photo, but the backlog contains no story to upload/set/change a profile photo or avatar. Missing complementary requirement: a story to allow users to upload or set their thumbnail/profile photo (e.g., 'As a user, I want to upload or select a profile photo/avatar').

evaluations.evidence: As a developer, I want to have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance is a non-functional/developer requirement and does not expose a missing complementary functional story in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a developer, I want to have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Glossary/story definitions are developer artifacts and need no complementary user stories to be implementable in this backlog context.

evaluations.evidence: As a developer, I want to have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Performance optimization story is self-contained; no functional complementary capability is absent from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a developer, I want to have the application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Browser compatibility is a quality requirement and does not reveal a missing complementary functional story in this backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a developer, I want to have the site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility requirement is non-functional and does not expose a missing complementary feature story.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance requirement is represented (e.g., PP-045 indexes) and does not expose a missing complementary functional story.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a platform/internationalization requirement and doesn't imply a missing complementary story in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design is a UI/UX requirement and doesn't indicate a missing complementary functional capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error pages are part of UI/UX non-functional requirements and do not expose a missing complementary feature story.

evaluations.evidence: As a Researcher, I want results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Anonymized storage is explicitly requested; the backlog contains privacy/account stories that allow implementing this without missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: As a Mike, I want to be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics request is present; required complementary data collection and export stories (transcript/export PP-017..PP-019) and non-identifiable storage (PP-052) enable implementation—no missing story.
